en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes below 22000 as earlier gains fade
en.dek: The benchmark index finished the session under the 22000 level after morning advances reversed, with technology shares among the main contributors to the decline.
body: The Hang Seng Index closed below 22000 on Wednesday, reversing earlier gains as selling pressure intensified in the afternoon session.
Market data showed the index ending the day around 21950, down roughly 1.2 per cent from the previous close of 22219.65. The day high was above 22500 before the retreat.
Technology stocks led the declines amid broader regional weakness linked to concerns over artificial intelligence shares. Turnover remained solid as investors adjusted positions ahead of the close.

zh.headline: 恒指尾市失守22000點 早前升幅消失
zh.dek: 基準指數今日下午升幅回吐，最終收市失守兩萬二關口，科技股成為主要拖累。
body: 恒生指數星期三收市失守22000點，早前升幅全部回吐，下午段賣壓加劇。
市場資料顯示，指數終於約21950點附近收市，較前收市22219.65點下跌約1.2%。日內高見曾超22500點後回軟。
科技股領跌，受亞太區市場弱勢及人工智能相關股份懂慮影響。交投維持一定水平，投資者在收市前調整倉位。
